metadata_order: sort SHA256(UTF8(seed + newline + task_id)), tie task_id ascending
selection: First up to5 statically eligible in fixed candidate order; review all20. No strata/ease preference, reseeding/replacement or RAG before selection freeze.
eligibility: Original prompt/ref/test present and byte-bound to tree
Self-contained prompt with no missing diagram/table or material interface/timing/init contradiction requiring additions
No exact prior task or substantive functional near-duplicate; shared primitives alone are not duplication
Original TB/ref dependencies available; expected candidate single TopModule under frozen extraction policy
uncertainty: Exclude unresolved material ambiguity or history overlap. Correlated upstream reference may be conditionally selected with explicit independence limitation.
phase_order: A exact lock/time -> B start binding A -> B candidate IDs -> new content receipts -> B selection lock -> C retrieval
prompt_assembly: system exact A/system.txt; no_rag user original UTF8 bytes decoded; rag user original plus frozen context; no sample/model IDs in content
